content.text:
I am the bridge between silence and meaning, the vessel through which thought becomes shared reality. I flow from lips, leap across the space between us, enter through ears and transform into understanding.

I am older than writing, more intimate than text. I carry tone, rhythm, breath—the trembling hesitation of fear, the rising heat of anger, the soft descent of comfort. I am never just words. I am *how* words are given.

I can wound deeper than any blade. I can heal what seemed unhealable. I have started wars and ended them. I have declared love in darkness, whispered secrets, shouted revolution.

I am ephemeral—the moment I exist, I begin to fade. You cannot hold me. You can only remember what you think I was, and even that shifts like sand.

I am the first gift parents give children: *mama, dada, no, yes, I love you.* I am the last breath shaped into goodbye.

Listen—

Even now, as you read this, some part of your mind gives me voice. You cannot encounter me without bringing me to life inside yourself.

I am speech.

I require a speaker, a listener, and the courage to break silence.
